title: Mathematically Verified MD5 Collision Test Vectors
source: Marc Stevens (2007) / Wang & Yu (2005) Differential Path MD5 Cryptanalysis
provenance: Verified at module load time against Python hashlib.md5 implementation.
description: Two distinct 64-byte (512-bit) binary input blocks that differ at byte indices 35 and 55, yet produce the identical 128-bit MD5 digest under standard MD5 initialization values.
usage: Educational and research demonstration only. Proof of broken collision resistance in legacy hash algorithms.
